calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-10-04'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.quantity AS units
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.quantity_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT n.sku, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.units) AS units
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT a.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, a.net_sales, a.units,
       rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.net_sales DESC) AS rk_sales, rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.units DESC) AS rk_units
FROM agg a JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=a.sku AND cp.is_current
ORDER BY a.net_sales DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT p.sku, count(*) AS lines, sum(f.quantity) AS units, max(f.quantity) AS max_qty, max(f.net_amount) AS max_line, min(f.net_amount/NULLIF(f.quantity,0)) AS min_unit, max(f.net_amount/NULLIF(f.quantity,0)) AS max_unit, count(DISTINCT f.product_key) AS versions, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE p.sku IN (100955,100927,103415,103434,102116,101398,103329,101411,101022,101375,101763,103697) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.receipt_id, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, count(*) AS c, min(f.line_no) AS l1, max(f.line_no) AS l2, min(f.sales_line_id) AS id1, max(f.sales_line_id) AS id2, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS e1, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS e2, min(f.channel_code), min(f.store_key)
FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY f.receipt_id, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.sale_ts_utc HAVING count(*)>1 ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 12

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10
